report:
Fallopian tubes, sterilisation

Received in formalin are two segments of fallopian tube measuring 2 and 2.5 cm in length. All embedded in 2 blocks.

(1) Left fallopian tube. (2) Right fallopian tube.

Sections show complete cross sections of fallopian tube from both sides with unremarkable plicae. There is no evidence of malignancy.

FALLOPIAN TUBES, bilateral, sterilisation - NO SIGNIFICANT PATHOLOGY
